home.title: daily.place
home.subtitle: Create your perfect space to focus on your daily tasks
home.description1: Everything is saved and available in your browser under a name of your choosing.
home.description2: By default, everything is saved in your browser's local storage. Sign in to sync your tasks to the cloud.
home.description3: With your account, your tasks are available on all your devices. Sync and work from anywhere!
home.tool1Description: Set up your timer and relax with short and long breaks. It keeps track of your pomodoros for the day.
home.tool2Description: Create, edit, reorder and check off your tasks for the day.
home.tool3Description: Lofi, rain, coffee shop, forest… Mix them and control the volume of each one.
home.tool4Description: Control the pomodoro without taking your hands off the keyboard.
home.tool5Description: Everything saved under your name. With an account, on all your devices.
home.tool6Description: For those who enjoy the night.
home.heroDescription: Pomodoro, to-do list and background sounds in a single place under your name. Nothing to install, no account needed.
home.howItWorksTitle: One name, and your place is ready.
home.toolsTitle: Just what you need to focus. Nothing more.
home.ctaDescription: Free, no ads and no account required.
